fato_historico: 2011: The United States military ends its "don't ask, don't tell" policy, allowing gay men and women to serve openly for the first time.

It is a good time to embrace honesty and express your true self, allowing your vibrant spirit to connect more deeply with those who cherish your unique perspective.
frase_do_dia: Let your true voice ring clear and embrace the freedom of being yourself.
